description: Set privacy and permissions on a folder. Requires folder_id or folder_name, private flag, and entries array.

entries.description: Array of permission entries { id, type, permission_level }.

private.description: Set to private (true) or public (false). Required.

space_id.description: Space ID to scope name lookup.

space_name.description: Space name to scope name lookup.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: set_folder_permissions
